provenance.historicalHardware: catalog-2016-2020/*.json manufacturer evidence and explicitly labeled gaps
provenance.procurementParameters: original game design proposal, not historical wholesale terms
provenance.supplierTraits: game positioning, not real manufacturer quality or reliability claims
provenance.economics: price curves and business balance remain subject to the separate economics review

channels.eligibility: legal product in current calendar; stock and compatibility checked
channels.note: All eligible brands can be bought in single units. The stock value is a simulation proposal per SKU, not a global limit or historical retailer inventory.

channels.eligibility: Five identical physical SKUs per line; not tied to company level
channels.note: A five-unit quote may suit a proven standard product. It is always optional for custom commissions.

channels.eligibility: Explicit confirmed delivery batch and 20 identical units per line; no promise of stock before launch
channels.note: Consolidated channel order, not a claim that every real brand accepts direct factory orders from small companies. Bulk ties up cash and stock without granting extra customer demand.

quotation.costFormula: ceil(baseGamePrice * marketFactor * channelFactor) per unit; shipping allocated by paid line subtotal
quotation.rounding: integer game coins per quoted unit
quotation.validUntil: first of stock event, calendar settlement or simulated deadline

lifecycle.trigger: platform or physical product announcement; stock remains zero
approved supply month and physical variant window
explicit game clearance event; existing compatibility stays valid

lifecyclePolicy.launchPremium: supplied by economics; no automatic premium in this file
lifecyclePolicy.openingLegacyStock: Approved pre-2016 products start regular; a contemporary webpage alone is insufficient historical proof
lifecyclePolicy.unknownLaunch: inferred supply month stays labeled and may move; official dates are not overwritten

fulfillment.quoteToConfirmation: validate timeline, physical variant, stock, quantity, cash and transaction id atomically
fulfillment.resumeAndOffline: Same elapsed simulation and transaction ledger as online; no second stock refresh, receipt or debit
fulfillment.monthBoundary: Player settlement alone changes month; outstanding delivery is carried forward with paid price and reservation

inspection.sampleMeaning: One inspected unit is a draft tutorial simplification; sampling does not establish real batch defect rates
inspection.failureRateSource: game balance by part revision, operating conditions and player QC, never blanket real-brand reputation
inspection.inferredPhysicalFields: must be present in an approved game profile before assembly; retain inferred status in the reference library

returns.openedWrongPurchase: retained inventory; no automatic full refund
returns.arrivalDefect: replacement or original-cost refund for rejected units; linked to original lot and paid order
returns.refundUpperBound: unconsumed return quantity * original allocated unit cost; never current market price
returns.warrantyMeaning: game proposal; not a reproduction of real brand warranty periods

mandatory: CPU support by exact board and BIOS
substitution.warning: Same brand, socket name or nominal wattage does not establish compatibility
substitution.savedDesignBehavior: copy as revision, display cost/score/layout/thermal changes, retest; preserve original
substitution.customerApproval: explain revised deliverable against existing requirements in the order flow
substitution.standardProductBatch: one approved revision per batch; reserve matching inventory

events.globalHistoricalShock: reference cue only; exact prices, shortage quantities and duration are original game events
events.forecast: say what is known, when the next check occurs, and what alternatives remain

reviewDecisions: Approve new candidate supplier and product series names
Choose visible per-year assortment from the larger reference catalog
Calibrate channel MOQ, delivery hours, stock, discount and return parameters with economics
Approve explicit game profiles for unknown reference connector and geometry fields
Choose fictional market events and retirement dates without claiming historic price reconstruction
